title: VTA Contexts Preview-Delete — payload
description: Request payload for vta/contexts/preview-delete: what deleting this context would destroy, computed without destroying it.

id.description: Context to preview the deletion of.

Response.title: VTA Contexts Preview-Delete — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vta/contexts/preview-delete. Every array is what WOULD be affected; nothing has been. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/contexts/preview-delete/1.0#response.

keys.description: Key ids that would be destroyed. A derived key can be re-derived from the seed; an internally-generated one cannot be recovered by any means, and this list does not distinguish them — a consumer rendering it for a human SHOULD resolve each key before presenting the choice.

webvhDids.description: did:webvh DIDs that would stop being served. Anything that recorded one as an issuer or subject is left pointing at nothing.

aclEntriesRemoved.description: Subjects whose ACL entry would be removed outright, because this context was its only scope.

aclEntriesUpdated.description: Subjects whose ACL entry would be narrowed — they hold other scopes and keep them.

didTemplates.description: DID templates scoped to this context that would be removed.
